lead.headline: Drug companies logged 47,607 doctor meals at exactly $125.00 in 2024, against 675 at $126.00
lead.number: 2024 meals: 47,607 at $125.00 and 20,666 at $124.99 vs 675 at $126.00 and 192 at $123.99; AstraZeneca 11.1 per 1,000 meals just under $125, Pfizer 0.6.
lead.watch_out: $125 is a company policy cap, not a law, so this is a fingerprint, not harm.
